sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State, on instruction, submits that notice has been served on the informant/victim on 29.07.2023 indicating therein that the matter shall be taken up on today (18.08.2023).
There is no appearance on behalf of the informant/victim when the matter is called.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No.35 of 2023, pending in the file of learned Additional District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhadrak, arising out of Basudevpur P.S. Case No.211 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376(AB)/506 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned A.D.J.-cum-Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Bhadrak by order dated 22.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 19.04.2023 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 16.06.2023, he may be released on bail.
6. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim aged about 5 years and that of her mother.

8. Leave is granted to the petitioner to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin after examination of the victim and her mother.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
